notes.notes:
Updates


Added support latest FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) technology from AMD

notes.title: Hotfix for Game Launch Issues
notes.notes:
Add more error checking and logging for NVIDIA Streamline 
 Add entries in settings.ini for controlling  for NVIDIAStreamlineLog, NVIDIAStreamlineOTAUpdates
[code]NVIDIAStreamlineLog=Off           ; Values: Off, Default, Verbose
NVIDIAStreamlineOTAUpdates=On     ; Values: Off, On[/code]
  When NVIDIAStreamlineLog enabled, a log file in the Save Game directory will be generated and overwritten every launch. If encountering errors, please submit a support ticket including this log.
[code]C:\Users\\Saved Games\God of War Ragnarök\sl.log[/code]
  When disabling NVIDIAStreamlineOTAUpdates, the driver over the air updates will be disabled. If encountering errors, please try disabling.
 Update the PlayStation Overlay runtime installers to version 4.00

notes.title: Black Screen Launch Issue Hotfix
notes.notes:
An NVIDIA Driver Crash/Soft Lock that prevents the game from loading is under investigation. In the meantime, we've implemented a work around for the cause of the crash to change how shader compilation works. This change may cause some micro-stuttering during initial load, but will hopefully avoid the driver crash that prevents game from starting.

Please verify files after patching.

notes.title: Update to Edit Appearance Feature & Armor of the Black Bear Set
notes.notes:
Tomorrow on January 30th we will be releasing a patch to the PC and PlayStation versions of God of War Ragnarök with a few changes. 

Update to Edit Appearance Feature (AKA Transmog System) 
For all PlayStation and PC players, the Edit Appearance feature (AKA the Transmog system), will no longer require gear to be fully upgraded to level 9 and will instead be available from the beginning of the game.  

Armor of the Black Bear Set 
Updated PS4 & PS5 Access to the Armor of the Black Bear Set  
After this update, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 players will also get access to the Armor of the Black Bear set (no NG+ save required) via the first available Lost Items chest in new and in-progress saves. 

PlayStation Network Sign-in Bonus on PC 
When signed into an account for the PlayStation Network when playing God of War Ragnarök on PC, you will gain access to the Armor of the Black Bear set for Kratos at the first Lost Items chest in the Realm Between Realms (previously only accessible in a New Game+ run) and a resource bundle.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040501/48a005551dec2c6946428470f9879b01e273ff67.jpg
This set includes:  

Cloak of the Black Bear (Chest)  
Wraps of the Black Bear (Wrist) 
Belt of the Black Bear (Waist)  


The resource bundle includes:  
500 Hacksilver 
250 XP

For in-progress saves, you will be able to access the armor set and resource bundle in the Lost Items chest after the update is live.  

If you do not wish to log-in to an account for PlayStation Network while playing God of War Ragnarök on PC, you will still be able to access the Armor of the Black Bear set in a New Game+ run (the same as before).  

Signing into the PlayStation Network will now be optional on God of War Ragnarök PC.

notes.title: Patch 7 Released
notes.notes:
Updates


 Added more detection for corrupted files during content loading with a warning to user to validate files
 Fixed an issue where the window location would not be saved upon subsequent launches when running in windowed mode
 Fixed an issue where the camera would drift when playing with mouse and alt-tabbing
 Fixed issues with volumetric fog looking blocky when playing in 21:9 or 32:9 aspect ratios
 Fixed an issue with interact/evade swapping not working when using SteamInput
 Fixed an issue with on screen prompts not properly reflecting correct button prompts when using Switch controller and SteamInput
 Fixed Quick Turn buttons not working with SteamInput
 Fixed an issue where bindings using mouse scroll would get unset upon relaunching the game
 Improved performance on Intel ARC GPUs (has very minor improvement on NVIDIA and AMD)
 Fixed a number of visual bugs such as the water at the bottom of Alfheim well not appearing properly

Note - We recommend validating files after every patch.

notes.title: Patch 6 Released
notes.notes:
Updates


 Fixed a crash in UI when opening certain Journal pages
 Fixed a crash that could happen when controllers get disabled or enabled in rapid succession
 Fixed a crash that would occur in various locations in Vanaheim
 Improved performance of AMD Zen1 and Zen2 processors in areas where the game was CPU limited
 Increased tessellation in Realm Between Realms back to PS5 quality
 Note that the performance issue related to tessellation is resolved in NVIDIA drivers 565.90 or higher
 Fixed an issue where lock on would rapidly bounce between targets when using mouse. It will now be more "sticky" requiring more effort to change targets
 Fixed an issue where attack indicators would not look correct when using frame generation
 Fixed an issue where cinematic dialogue audio would be lower volume than intended

notes.title: Patch 5 Released
notes.notes:
Updates

 Prevent crash on game boot due to corrupt or missing files - game will now tell you that there are bad files and ask you to verify installation
 Volumetric fog in Realm Between Realms and during dream sequences will now appear properly on NVIDIA 10xx, 20xx, and 30xx cards
 DualSense controllers will now default to rumble backup when connected wirelessly as haptics are only available with wired connections 
 Achievements will now retroactively unlock when loading save games

Please note: If you reload your save and your missing Achievements do not pop, this is likely due to something causing the Steam API to fail via a temporary block such as a firewall, internet disabled, etc. Please double-check possible blockers if this issue persists after reloading.

notes.title: Patch 4 Released
notes.notes:
Updates

Crashes

 Fixed a crash that would sometimes occur when looking at the Skill tree
 Fixed a crash related to authentication flow when booting the game

Authentication Flow

 Fixed multiple issues related to authentication flow and provided more communication as to what is happening to the user

Game Textures

 Fixed an issue where game textures would unload while looking at the menu for a period of time
 Fixed an issue where textures and models would be shown loading in while using fast travel through the Realm Between Realms

NVIDIA Memory Leak

 Replaced NVIDIA Streamline to resolve an issue with memory leaks when switching between different Frame Gen settings

AMD Fixes 

 Fixed AMD FSR-FG flickering when in the pause menu
 Fixed AMD FSR-FG performance and frame pacing issues
 Fixed small memory leak when AMD FSR-FG on and off

Steam Deck Offline Mode

 Fixed an issue where Steam Input would not work when playing in Offline mode

DualSense Controller

 Fixed an issue where the DualSense controller would not work wirelessly

notes.title: Patch 3 Released
notes.notes:
Updates
Spatial Audio

 Fixed crash related to spatial audio that could occur in multiple locations throughout the game with random intervals
 Fixed an issue with audio dropping out when spatial audio was enabled

Mouse Input/Camera

 Fixed mouse input focus issue where mouse would not control camera, but could still control menus
 Moved mouse controls to use raw input instead of GameInput driver

HDR

 Fixed an issue where HDR would not retain its setting on subsequent game starts

VRAM Utilization

 Texture Quality now uses fixed sized texture caches in VRAM instead of growing to use all of available VRAM
 VRAM usage shown in the settings menu now reflects the amount of VRAM allocated based on the current settings as a percentage of amount recommended by operating system. Usage over 100% will work but can lead to performance degradation.
 Modified VRAM texture cache algorithm to reduce VRAM usage that may have caused performance to degrade over time

Controller

 Fixed an issue with 3rd party controllers having stick drift

Animation

 Fixed animation issues in 32:9 super ultrawide screen in Open Your Heart cinematic

notes.title: Patch 2 Released
notes.notes:
Updates

 Fixed an issue where NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation would not properly initialize
 Fixed an issue with NVIDIA Reflex would show as disabled in the UI when enabling Frame Generation
 Fixed some timing markers with NVIDIA Reflex
 Fixed the UI not showing Surround Sound in Audio Calibration
 Fixed an issue where surround sound would apply stereo audio mixing causing some sounds to be too quiet or loud
 Fixed UI controller icons being low resolution and blurry in some cases
 Fixed an issue where controls would not work during quicktime events if Interact/Evade were swapped in addition to having Steam Input enabled
 Fixed an issue on Steam Deck with a button not being mapped blocking completing a tutorial moment
 No longer blocking GPUs with less than 6GB of VRAM from launching the game

Please note that a 6GB card is still the required spec. 4GB cards are not supported and you may encounter performance issues or crashes. Play at your own risk.

notes.title: God of War Ragnarok release date and launch times
notes.notes:
God of War Ragnarok is launching on PC this week. After a very successful PS5 launch, it's about time we got to adventure alongside Kratos and Atreus again. But, there isn't a single time everyone will be able to start playing, which might be frustrating for those who have been waiting a while already. To make sure you know exactly when you'll be able to jump in, we've got the unlock time for each region so you'll be able to finetune your countdowns...
                Read more.
